Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE new KFB 3x2 landscape transparent PNG character sheet, EXACTLY SIX unique absurd-surreal weird claymation INK BLOB MONSTERS, a fictional retro Die Auszeitbehörde sports team. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets: image1 rounded sculpted whole ink-body material; image2 handcrafted prop/material craft. Do not copy source costume, eyes or repeated grins. 1940s-inspired faded teal-and-ochre basketball club, narrow cotton jersey front panels, brown leather panelled balls. Warm offbeat physical cartoon acting with satirical vulnerable personalities, no glossy Pixar-human clichés.
BODY LOCK: Every character is one complete continuous FOOTLESS charcoal-black ink splat with subtle dark violet sheen, softly rounded thick asymmetric lobes, a few droplets, huge face directly in goo and short goo hands. Upright facing camera, full silhouette. NO human torso, legs, feet, trouser anatomy, cropped bust, animal body, alternate material body. Sports are expressed through hands, facial acting and props. Costumes are SMALL collar/shoulder/front-bib accents, bare ink dominates. Premium handmade plasticine fingerprint texture, rounded rich volumes, softly lit upper left. Every visible eye has WHITE/IVORY sclera around RED iris around BLACK pupil; thick fully filled purple-black eyelids. Helmets/visors do not cover eyes. Female-read cues subtly sculpted lids/lashes/quiff, no breasts or human hips. Six different mouth actions and bodily shapes. Teeth ONLY descend from upper gum INSIDE open mouth; never on outside lower lip, closed mouths toothless. No human pink lipstick.
TOP LEFT — Paula Passgenau; female-read. Slim comma-shaped upright blob with modest quiff/lashes, one sharply raised eyelid, toothless cool smirk; teal headband and small ochre-edged jersey bib; one hand directs, other balances a brown leather basketball at waist.
TOP MIDDLE — Egon Eigenwurf; male-read. Round star-lobed blob with high uneven eyes and deliriously proud open grin, two upper teeth; tiny teal jersey bib, holds both empty goo hands in an exaggerated delicate follow-through near his face.
TOP RIGHT — Willi Wechselwinkel; male-read. Tall bent pear splat, worried crooked brow, tiny closed sideways mouth; ochre sweatband slightly slipping, small teal collar; holds a folded towel shaped into a simple unexpected triangle.
BOTTOM LEFT — Greta Gegenbrett; female-read. Broad square-lobed blob, two filled thick eyelids with lashes, stubborn closed frown; ochre neck trim and small teal jersey panel; hugs a scuffed brown basketball tightly as if it were the last hot-water bottle.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — Otto Oberkante; male-read. Very tall slender rounded ink tower with drooping crest yet fits cell; huge bashful white eyes, small astonished mouth with no visible teeth; tiny teal collar, one old canvas high-top shoe held in a goo hand as lucky charm, no legs or feet.
BOTTOM RIGHT — Bert Bankreserve; male-read. Wide flattened but upright blob, deeply unimpressed half-lidded stare, compressed long mouth; old teal warm-up jacket as SMALL open shoulder cape, holds one squat thermos and a single folded towel on shoulder.
COMPOSITION: landscape 1536x1024, three equal columns by two equal rows, equal generously sized character scale in BOTH rows. Each silhouette and all props fit approximately 450x440px within its 512x512 logical cell with at least32px clean transparent gutters. Keep all6 substantial, no tiny bottom row, no automatic excessive padding, no overlap or clipping. No ground, floor, field, court, scenelet, shadows disc, labels, lettering, jersey numbers, logos, real brands, team names in pixels, grid lines, frame, scenery. True transparent background. Individual actors must also read alone. Restrained one/two bold coherent identity anchors; avoid extra clutter or inherited tongue gags.
